'Q51':('1. Peacocking may place Large Bird Aviary before Build II; zoo must not already have one and a legal site must exist. 2. All other placement restrictions remain, including Build II for restricted-icon spaces. 3. Posturing uses ordinary placement rules including kiosk spacing, placing multiple buildings sequentially.', 'Peacocking; Posturing.'),
'Q52':('1. First Petting Zoo animal grants 3 appeal, second 6, third 9. 2. The single Petting Zoo holds at most three such animals. 3. They count as small animals.', 'Petting Zoo animal.'),
'Q53':('1. Acting player chooses target among tied leaders separately for each Pilfering 2 selection. 2. Highest-appeal target must have 5+ appeal; conservation target must have 5+ appeal and at least 1 conservation. If all have zero conservation, that part has no effect while high-appeal part still resolves. 3. If same zoo leads both, it can be selected twice. 4. Self-target selection has no effect; another Pilfering 2 selection still resolves.', 'Pilfering X.'),
'Q54':('1. Target chooses five money or a random hand-card draw; Final Scoring cards are never drawn. 2. With no hand cards, give five money; with less than five money, give a card. 3. 'Q55':('1. Pouch-tucked cards have no remaining function; if animal is released, discard tucked cards too, retaining appeal already earned. 2. Sunbathing-sold cards go to discard pile.', 'Pouch X; Sunbathing X.'),
'Q56':('1. An extra Final Scoring card drawn before 10-conservation milestone joins the cards from which you discard one at that milestone. 2. At game end score every remaining card, each capped at 4 conservation.', 'Resistance.'),
'Q57':('1. Shuffle discard pile face down and draw randomly; make the stated selection, then return discard pile face up. Scavenging 3 draws three random cards, keeps one, and discards the others.', 'Scavenging.'),
'Q58':('1. Snapping takes exactly one display card regardless of reputation; it does not draw from deck. 2. Sponsor Magnet can take display Sponsors without reputation restriction; if none present, nothing happens. 3. Ordinary end-of-turn display refill applies.', 'Snapping; Sponsor Magnet.'),
'Q59':('1. Place Venom tokens on lowest-slot cards first (1, then 2, etc.), at most one per card; return duplicates. 2. If unable, undo turn and choose another action; cannot avoid fee by spending money. 4. Unused tokens clear at next break.', 'Venom X.'),
'Q63':('1. Veterinarian gives 2/5/10 money for 1/2/3 universities. 2. Conservation project support requires strength 4 rather than 5. 3. Final reward: 1 conservation for three universities.', '203 Veterinarian.'),
'Q66':('1. Medical Breakthrough gives 2 appeal per previously supported project, counted by missing left-map tokens. 2. At each break it gives 1 conservation.', '206 Medical Breakthrough.'),
'Q67':('1. Count different continent and animal-category icon types together, excluding research; each type once, even duplicates/doubled icons. 2. Owner gains 1 conservation per two types, rounded down. 3. Every other player gets 2 money per conservation point owner gains.', '207 Basic Research.'),
'Q68':('1. Science Library gives 1 appeal per research icon on play. 2. Whenever any player plays a research icon, Library owner gains 2 money. 3. Final reward is 1 conservation with five different animal categories.', '208 Science Library.'),
'Q70':('1. Expert on Americas gives 1 appeal per Americas icon on play. 2. Each Americas icon played permits a free kiosk under normal placement and spacing rules. 3. Final reward: 1 conservation with five or more kiosks.', '210 Expert on the Americas.'),
'Q72':('1. Expert on Australia gives 1 appeal per Australia icon on play. 2. For each Australia icon played, may tuck one hand card under Sponsor for 2 appeal. 3. Tucked cards have no further function.', '212 Expert on Australia.'),
'Q75':('1. When played, each card stores two tokens taken from own supply on its two printed top spaces. 2. When supporting a base project below Association board, return exactly one of this Sponsor’s tokens to supply as any one icon; cannot spend both on same project. 3. Base-origin cards played above board do not qualify. 4. Final reward: 1 conservation with five or more project supports, counted by missing map tokens.', '215 Global Breeding Program; 218 Breeding Program.'),
'Q77':('1. Each Build action can add one extra copy of a building built in that same action without extra strength. 2. Pay normal cost and obey placement; special enclosures still limited to one each; only one extra building allowed. 3. Final reward: 5 appeal with full map except water/rock.', '217 Engineer.'),
'Q78':('1. Gives 2 money per water/rock icon on play. 2. Covered terrain no longer counts for Hydrologist, Geologist, or Architectural Zoo. 4. Final reward: 2 appeal per water/rock icon pair, at most 3 pairs (6 appeal).', '219 Diversity Researcher.'),
'Q80':('1. Each actual placement bonus on border space triggers an additional choice of any uncovered placement bonus on map. 2. The extra bonus need not be on border. 3. 'Q82':('1. Migration Recording gives 1 X-token on play. 2. Each Release into the Wild support yields 1 extra conservation. 3. Each token counts as separate project support for other effects.', '224 Migration Recording.'),
'Q83':('1. Quarantine Lab gives 1 X-token on play. 2. Immune to Venom, Constriction, Hypnosis, Pilfering; for Hypnosis/Pilfering ignore its counters and find next qualifying player. 3. Final reward: 1 conservation with all five continents.', '225 Quarantine Lab.'),
'Q85':('1. Permanently choose small or large, mark box with supply token, reveal deck cards until finding that animal type, keep it and discard others. 2. Cannot play opposite type. 3. Chosen small animals gain 2 extra appeal, chosen large gain 4; size-3 animals remain legal but gain no bonus.', '227 WAZA Special Assignment.'),
'Q86':('1. Gives 2 money per small animal on play. 2. An Animals action containing only small animals may play one extra small animal from hand at normal costs/rules. 3. Then add one small animal from display to hand regardless of reputation; may take it even if declined extra play. Mixed small and large prevents effect.', '228 WAZA Small Animals Program.'),
'Q90':('1. Hydrologist gives 1 appeal per water icon on play. 2. Each newly covered space adjacent to water earns 1 money, even multiple spaces of one building; a space beside multiple water hexes pays only once. 3. Final reward: 1 conservation if all water hexes connected (none isolated).', '241 Hydrologist.'),
'Q95':('1. Barred Owl Hut is a unique building Sponsor; place unique building. 2. Each bird icon played draws two deck cards, keeps one and discards the other.', '249 Barred Owl Hut.'),
'Q96':('1. Sea Turtle Tank unique building must be adjacent to water. 2. Each reptile icon played lets you sell up to two hand cards for 4 money each; discard sold cards.', '250 Sea Turtle Tank.'),
'Q98':('1. Each predator icon played triggers Hunter with draws equal to your total predator icons. 2. A card with two predator icons triggers two sequential Hunters, counting both new icons each time.', '252 Spotted Hyena Compound.'),
'Q99':('1. Place building with three supply tokens on its card. 2. Per herbivore icon played, may spend one token and pay money equal to a hand Sponsor’s level to play that Sponsor, meeting normal conditions. 3. Its own icon may trigger this when Stable is played. 4. Three uses total; card source is hand only.', '253 Okapi Stable.'),
'Q100':('1. Zoo School gives 1 reputation and 1 conservation. 2. Place building covering at least two border spaces. 3. Take one in-range display card or draw one deck card; simultaneous benefits may be resolved in chosen order.', '254 Zoo School.'),
'Q102':('1. Side Entrance unique building occupies two border spaces and need not touch existing building; other placement rules apply. 2. Later buildings may attach to it. 3. Final reward: 5 appeal with full map excluding water/rock.', '257 Side Entrance.'),
'Q104':('1. Immediate appeal is 1 per connected uncovered building border space, never water/rock. 2. Final: 1 conservation per six contiguous empty building spaces; score groups separately, e.g. groups 13,6,3,2 yield 3 total. 3. Restricted spaces count even if Build not upgraded; terrain spaces excluded.', '260 Native Farm Animals.'),
'Q106':('1. Immediate money is 2 per different continent/animal-category icon, excluding research. 2. Each category/continent newly introduced grants 1 appeal and 2 money. 3. A newly played double identical icon gives novelty once.', '262 Explorer.'),
'Q107':('1. Gives free size-5 standard enclosure under ordinary placement rules. 2. When playing large animal, ignore one left-side condition, such as required icon or Animals upgrade; terrain cannot be ignored. 3. Stacks with Research Institute to ignore two conditions.', '263 WAZA Large Animal Program.'),
'Q112':('1. Gain 1 conservation per animal category where your zoo has more icons than player to your right. 2. If they have zero in a category, one of yours is enough. 3. Maximum 4 conservation.', 'Biodiverse Zoo (009).'),
'Q113':('1. Only standard enclosures adjacent to Observation Tower hex qualify, not merely another rock hex. 2. Special enclosures do not qualify. 3. Housing there gives the two appeal again after an earlier animal was released. 4. Tower is not a building for kiosk income.', 'Map 1, Observation Tower.'),
'Q114':('1. Standard enclosure touching Outdoor Area hex qualifies, not merely another water hex. 2. It counts as two spaces larger for all purposes after placement (e.g., physical size 2 treated as 4). 3. Cannot ignore for release or transfer. 4. No special-enclosure effect; Outdoor Area is not a building.', 'Map 2, Outdoor Areas.'),
'Q115':('1. A building on Harbor’s adjacent building space activates it; first building may start beside Harbor but need not. 2. Discard ability usable once per own turn, before/during/after action; not during breaks or others’ turns. 3. Harbor is not a building.', 'Map 4, Commercial Harbor.'),
'Q116':('1. Restaurant break income is 1 money per adjacent covered hex, not per building; empty enclosures qualify and each hex counts. 2. Restaurant is not a building and gives zero income to adjacent kiosks. 3. Its placement bonus grants one free Reptile House or one free Large Bird Aviary, choice of one, even before Build II; other placement restrictions remain.', 'Map 5, Park Restaurant.'),
'Q119':('1. Cover H spaces with buildings under ordinary placement rules; each covered H reveals deck cards until Sponsor appears, keep it and discard others. 2. H is not placement bonus and does not trigger Archaeologist. 3. Once all three covered, every Sponsor level is one lower. 4. Third/fourth bonus partner zoos still require Association II; bonus buildings still require Build II for restricted spaces.', 'Map 8, Hollywood Hills.'),
'Q123':('1. Pay money equal to Sponsor level and meet normal play conditions. 2. Use hand only, even with Sponsors II; no display card. 3. Sponsors Action card stays in current slot and does not move.', 'Official base FAQ: paid-Sponsor effect.'),
'Q124':('1. Appeal cannot exceed 113; excess gains are lost. 2. Conservation cannot exceed 41; excess gains are lost.', 'Official base FAQ: Appeal and conservation limits.'),
'Q125':('1. Venom affects every other zoo with higher appeal and at least 5 appeal. 2. Hypnosis targets a highest-appeal zoo with 5+ (acting player chooses ties), and copies slot 1, 2, or 3. 3. Pilfering 1 targets highest appeal with 5+; Pilfering 2 separately targets highest appeal and most conservation, each 5+ (conservation target also at least 1 conservation); actor chooses ties. 4. Constriction affects every other 5+ appeal zoo ahead on appeal and/or conservation; one track lead gets token on slot 5, both gets tokens on slots 4 and 5.', 'Interactive target reference.'),
'Q127':('1. Animal partner-zoo condition means partner zoo from its continent; Sponsor partner condition allows any continent. 2. Maximum-25 appeal condition permits play only at 25 or below; marker is reminder, not general cap. 3. Minimum reputation requires at least printed value. 4. Minus-one-condition ignores one left-edge requirement only; all other conditions and terrain requirements remain.', 'Official base FAQ: conditions.'),
'Q133':('1. Each selection may either discard one display card and replenish it, or discard a hand card then draw one deck card. 2. Digging 2 allows up to two selections and may choose a different option each time.', 'Digging 2.'),
'Q134':('1. After display cards are taken, move higher-numbered cards down preserving their order. 2. Fill empty folders from deck. 3. Summary does not give any more specific sequencing for “final empty folders” beyond filling empty spaces from the deck.','Reputation track and display; display timing.'),
'Q137':('1. Build standard enclosure empty side up (yellow border and size number). 2. Each covered placement-bonus space grants bonus immediately, once; a standard enclosure later occupied does not grant it again.', 'BUILD action; placement rules.'),
'Q139':('1. Discard one Final Scoring card face down under the remaining pile.', 'Scoring: 10 conservation milestone.'),
'Q140':('1. Randomly determine starting player; turn order proceeds clockwise. 2. Game has no formal rounds; players take turns until end triggered, with breaks in between. 3. 'Q01':("1. Starting money: 25. 2. Workers: 1 active on the notepad and 3 inactive on the reserve spaces. 3. Zoo cards: draw 8, keep 4 and discard 4. 4. Final Scoring: draw 2. 5. 'Q02':("1. Base projects: with 4 players place the top 4 face up below the Association board; with 2 or 3 players place the top 3 face up there. 2. 'Q03':("1. After using the slot-4 card, remove it, shift the cards that were left of the empty slot one slot right, and put the used card in slot 1. 2. 'Q04':("1. You cannot take a regular action that does nothing: playing zero animals or building zero buildings is not legal. 2. 'Q05':("1. When the Break token reaches the last space, ignore steps beyond that space and gain 1 X-token. 2. The break occurs after the triggering player finishes the current turn. 3. 'Q06':("1. 'Q07':("1. Reputation range includes the display folder matching your reputation space and all lower-numbered folders. 2. Reputation 10 and above requires upgraded Cards. 3. 'Q08':("1. Build I builds exactly 1 building of size up to action strength. Build only on empty spaces; cannot overlap, leave the map, or cover water/rock. Restricted-icon spaces require Build II. 5. Each kiosk must be at least 3 spaces from every other kiosk. 6. Each pavilion immediately gives 1 appeal once.","Build action gives I/II limits, cost, placement, restricted spaces, kiosk spacing and pavilion benefit."),
'Q09':("1. Build I permits standard enclosures, kiosks, pavilions and one Petting Zoo (size 3); standard enclosures and kiosks/pavilions may be built multiple times. 2. Build II additionally permits one Reptile House and one Large Bird Aviary per zoo (each size 5); it also permits restricted-icon spaces. 3. 'Q10':("1. Yes. Immediate effects resolve at their stated point; ‘after finishing’ effects wait until the whole action and Action-card movement are complete. 3. If multiple effects are simultaneous, the owning player chooses their order.","Turn Structure says earlier bonuses may fund later steps and payment precedes own benefits; ‘after finishing’ and simultaneous effects rules."),
'Q11':("1. To play each animal, meet all left-side conditions, pay its full cost, and house it legally; money-gain effects from the play occur only after you can pay the full cost. 2. A partner zoo matching a continent on the animal reduces cost by 3 money per such continent icon (so a double icon reduces it by 6). 3. Standard housing: an eligible animal needs one empty standard enclosure at least its printed minimum size; flip the whole enclosure to occupied. Petting Zoo animals go only in the Petting Zoo. 4. Eligible reptiles and birds may use a Reptile House or Aviary if the alternative special-enclosure requirement fits; mark each occupied space with a supply player token and never flip the special enclosure. 5. Meet water/rock adjacency for the chosen enclosure; count distinct adjacent terrain hexes, not multiple edges to the same hex. 6. Advance appeal and resolve ordinary effects during the animal sequence; defer ‘after finishing’ effects until the whole Animals action ends and the Animals card moves. 'Q12':("1. Animals II may play animals from display folders within reputation range, paying the folder number as additional cost; the display is not replenished until turn end. 2. At strength 5+, you may gain 1 reputation at the very start of the action, before selecting animals, so the increased range applies. 3. Animals II permits animals with the upgrade-required condition icon.","Animals II adds display source/folder cost, optional reputation first at strength 5+, and upgrade-conditioned animals."),
'Q13':("1. Existing animals may move only immediately when a Reptile House or Large Bird Aviary is built, once per new building. For each moved animal, flip the smallest occupied standard enclosure that meets all its requirements, including terrain, to empty. If none meets all requirements, use the smallest occupied standard enclosure meeting size alone; if none meets even size, flip none. This relocation does not remove the animal from your zoo.","Build II and relocation section: only immediately at construction; all suitable animals that fit; mark spaces with tokens; smallest-enclosure/fallback sequence."),
'Q14':("1. Task strengths: reputation 2; partner zoo 3; university 4; conservation project work 5. 2. Association I performs exactly one task, with strength at least its printed value. Association II may perform one or more different tasks with total task value no greater than action strength. 3. Each task uses 1 worker unless you already have one of your workers on that task, when you must place 2; with 3 already there you cannot repeat it until after break. 4. Other players’ workers on a task do not matter.","Association action: tasks and strengths; side I/II limits; repeated-task worker rule and other players’ workers."),
'Q15':("1. Take partner zoos and universities from available tiles on the Association board and place them on the lowest open matching spaces on your map; immediately resolve any covered map-space bonus. 2. You cannot take a duplicate university; partner zoos must be from different continents, maximum four. Third/fourth partner zoos require Association II. 3. University tiles also grant their printed reputation immediately; only the hand-limit university raises hand limit from 3 to 5. 4. Partner zoos provide their continent icon and reduce matching-continent animal costs by 3 per icon. A tile cannot be acquired if unavailable on the board.","Association task descriptions, zoo map columns, university details and hand-limit table."),
'Q16':("1. A Conservation Project can enter play from your hand and be supported immediately through Association work; Association II also permits a new card from display within reputation range, paying its folder number. To support, fulfill a condition and choose a reward level with no player token on it; each level holds one token total, and normally you may support a given project only once. 3. Take one of your player tokens from the left edge of your zoo map and place it on that condition. Gain the project reward and activate the uncovered map bonus, in either order. 4. If a project above the board is pushed off by overflow, return its player tokens to their owners’ supplies; the map bonuses remain activated. Base projects below never move.","Association project work, support procedure and limits, token origin, reward/map bonus order, and overflow handling."),
'Q17':("1. Release project size categories must match the animal’s printed standard-enclosure requirement: 2− accepts size 1 or 2; 3 accepts exactly size 3; 4+ accepts 4 or 5. Retain conservation, reputation, ability-generated appeal and earlier effects already earned. 3. Playing a new Release project grants 1 reputation; later supporting it does not. 4. If the released animal could use a special enclosure and its required tokens can be removed, remove those tokens; otherwise flip the smallest occupied standard enclosure meeting all requirements, or the smallest meeting size alone as fallback, or none if none meets size.","Release into the wild procedure: exact printed size category, losses/retained rewards, project play reputation, housing release/fallback."),
'Q18':("1. Sponsors I: play exactly 1 Sponsor from hand; strength must be at least its level and all conditions must be met. Use hand and/or display within reputation range, pay each display folder number, and refill only at turn end. Resolve cards one by one, fully completing each instant effect before the next; defer after-finishing effects. 3. If choosing the break/money option on Sponsors II, advance the Break token and take money twice the action strength, even if only one space remains before the last space.","Sponsors I/II rules state level budgets, card sources/cost/refill, effect order, and doubled money option; break excess is ignored but full money is paid."),
'Q19':("1. Empty standard enclosures do not qualify; empty special enclosures do. 4. When multiple players take display cards during income, resolve affected players clockwise from the break initiator (or first affected player clockwise from them), refilling the display after each such player before the next chooses.","Break procedure steps and kiosk income; explicit between-player display refill/order rule."),
'Q20':("1. At 2 conservation, choose to upgrade an Action card or activate one additional worker. At 5 and 8, choose 5 money or an available Bonus tile; execute tile immediately and remove it. Check end at end of your own turn or during a break when Appeal and Conservation are in the same scoring area or pass one another. If appeal is gained on another player’s turn, the receiving zoo checks at the end of its own turn or during a break. 3. Triggering player completes their turn and each other player gets one more; a break trigger gives every player one more turn. 4. Each Final Scoring card can grant at most 4 conservation. VP equals appeal minus the lowest Appeal value in the scoring area containing your Conservation counter. Highest positive total wins; tie goes to most supported projects, then shared victory.","Conservation milestones; end timing/trigger/last turns; final scoring cap, formula and tiebreak."),
'Q21':("1. Shuffle 9 Bonus tiles; place one random tile face up on each of the four blank yellow spaces beside the Conservation track (two at 5 and two at 8); do not use the two yellow spaces with icons. Return the remaining five to the box. 2. Components are not limited by physical stock: use a suitable substitute if a component runs out, while honoring explicit per-zoo limits and Association-board availability rules.","Setup bonus tiles; component supply rule says use suitable substitute, with explicit limits still applying."),
'Q22':("1. Advanced Maps 1–8: either take 2 random zoo maps and choose one advanced map, or lay out player count +1 advanced maps and choose in reverse turn order. 2. Map A starts with an empty 3-space enclosure and a kiosk on the indicated spaces; the printed kiosk counts as built, with a kiosk tile placed over it as reminder.","Personal setup A gives advanced map selection methods and Map A starting buildings."),
'Q23':("1. The seven player tokens begin on the designated spaces at the left edge of your zoo map; the rest stay beside the map. 2. Hire/activate reserve workers from the lowest remaining space upward. 3. Certain maps give conservation points when you hire your last worker; Full-throated also directs you to take that map reward.","Personal setup C2; Association worker supply and Full-throated clarification."),
'Q24':("1. Flip one chosen side-I Action card to side II in its current slot; it does not move. 2. Its improved action is usable starting with your next action, but the card counts as upgraded immediately for conditions. 3. You cannot upgrade all five Action cards; one upgrade source allows an alternative choice, so not every card can be upgraded.","Upgrade Action cards: remains in slot; next-action use; immediate condition status; four paths and limitation."),
'Q25':("1. Cards I deck draws by strength 1–5: draw 1/discard 1; 1/0; 2/1; 2/0; 3/1. 2. A required discard may be one of the cards just drawn or a card already in your hand.","Cards draw tables; required discard may be new or previously held."),
'Q28':("1. The seven categories are bird, herbivore, predator, primate, reptile, bear, and Petting Zoo animal. 2. Bear remains a category even when it appears with herbivore or predator; Petting Zoo animal is its own category. Count both special categories unless the effect explicitly excludes them.","Base glossary names all seven categories and clarifies bear and Petting Zoo animal."),
'Q29':("1. Donations are Association II only; the card must be upgraded and you must have performed at least one association task in that same action. Skip spaces blocked at setup. 4. Once all spaces but the last are covered, each later donation costs 12 and places no further token.","Donations section gives eligibility, payment, supply token/reward, ladder and repeatable final space."),
'Q30':("1. Count upper-right icons on Animal and Sponsor cards; for Animal cards and unique-building Sponsor cards also count upper-left water/rock requirements. Count partner-zoo continent icons and university research icons. 2. Do not count left-side play conditions, conservation-project icons, university reputation award or hand-limit mark as zoo icons. 3. A card counts its own icons for effects; doubled icons count twice and trigger twice, but repeated icons count only once when an effect asks for different types. 4. Card text takes priority over general rules.","Glossary counting-icons rules and card-text priority."),
'Q31':("1. A requirement for two water/rock spaces means two distinct adjacent terrain hexes; multiple touching edges to one hex count as one. A larger terrain region counts only the individual hexes adjacent to the enclosure. 2. Connected terrain regions do not make distant hexes count as adjacent. 3. Water/rock illustrations printed on tiles are decorative and are not terrain spaces or requirements.","Terrain adjacency counts distinct hexes; tile illustrations provide neither terrain spaces nor requirements."),
'Q32':("1. Playing a new Release into the Wild project gives 1 reputation to the player who brings it into play; supporting it later gives no such play bonus. 2. 'Q33':("1. In X:Y, X is the condition and Y is the reward. 2. If the condition has no number or says ‘per,’ gain the reward once per fulfillment. 3. A numbered threshold pays only once; with several thresholds, use the highest one met.","Glossary X:Y rule."),
'Q34':("1. Connected space: uncovered and shares an edge with a covered space. 2. Isolated space: has no adjacent covered space. 3. 'Q35':("1. Unique buildings enter through their Sponsor and must be placed when that Sponsor is played; if placement is impossible, the card cannot be played. 2. Unique buildings are not enclosures, cannot house extra animals, and never count as water or rock spaces.","Unique building glossary rules."),
'Q36':("1. For either Named Action or Determination, finish the Animals action and move the Animals card to slot 1 before taking the granted action. 2. A named action cannot be replaced with the X-token action; Determination (Any Action) may choose any action, including X-token.","Action/Determination clarification gives shared timing, card movement and distinction on X-token action."),
'Q37':("1. Search the unused face-down base-project deck and take the chosen project (Assertion) or named project (Dominance) into hand; return the deck. 2. Dominance has no effect if its named project is already in play. 3. Later play and immediately support the acquired project through Association, placing it above the board, not in the base-project row below.","Assertion/Dominance clarification."),
'Q38':("1. Resolve Boost/Clever after finishing Animals and moving that card. 2. Clever moves the selected card to slot 1; cards formerly to its left shift right. 3. Boost moves the named card to slot 1 or 5; moving to 5 shifts cards formerly to its right left.","Boost/Clever clarification."),
'Q39':("1. Venom, Hypnosis, Pilfering 1, each separate Pilfering 2 target, and Constriction require each affected zoo to have at least 5 appeal. Apply the floor separately to every selected zoo. 2. Multiplayer groups may use the alternative text marked for solo on those cards without playing solo mode.","Interactive abilities shared eligibility and self-selection rules."),
'Q40':("1. Each affected other zoo places Constriction tokens on its own Action cards: if ahead on one track, one token on its slot-5 card; if ahead on both, one each on its slot-4 and slot-5 cards. 2. 'Q41':("1. A constricted card in slot 1 or 2 has effective strength below 1; you cannot use a regular action at zero or below. 2.     {"id":"Q10","answer":"1. Yes: bonuses gained earlier in an action, including money, cards, and newly activated workers, can be used in later steps of that same action. 2. Meet required water/rock adjacency at the chosen enclosure, including special enclosures; count distinct adjacent terrain hexes, not touching edges. 4. Resolve regular effects immediately; after-finishing effects wait until the whole Animals action ends.     {"id":"Q12","answer":"1. Animals II permits display animals within reputation range, in addition to hand animals. 2. Pay the display folder number as an additional cost. 3.     {"id":"Q13","answer":"1.     {"id":"Q14","answer":"1. Task strengths are reputation 2, partner zoo 3, university 4, conservation project work 5. 2.     {"id":"Q15","answer":"1. Take partner zoos/universities from the Association board and place on the lowest empty matching space on your zoo map. 2.     {"id":"Q16","answer":"1. Put one of your map-edge tokens on the chosen level; this comes from the left edge of your zoo map. 4.     {"id":"Q17","answer":"1.     {"id":"Q18","answer":"1. Sponsors I plays exactly one card from hand if strength meets its level and conditions are met.
